answer.report_md:
## 画出来要什么
一个分组柱状图：4 个类别槽（`Bottom 50%`、`Middle 40%`、`Top 10%`、`Top 1%`），每槽 2 根柱（绿=`Consumption`，红=`Private ownership`），共 8 根。左轴竖排标题 `Share in total emissions`，刻度 `0%`–`90%` 每 10% 一档，虚线横向网格，无竖网格。图内绘图区上方另有一行图内标题 `Emissions shares by groups`，与编号标题 `Figure 6.2.` 两行大标题分属两层。图例位于绘图区下方居中。每根柱顶端外侧印带百分号的数值（`77%`、`3%`）。图下是十余行 `Interpretation.` 说明块，末尾接 `Sources and series:`，再下是双栏正文。

## 定位一个值难在哪
以 `20%` 为例：它必须同时由类别刻度 `Middle 40%` 与图例项 `Private ownership` 两个标签共同定位；而类别名本身含百分数（`Top 10%`、`Top 1%`），检索值 `10` 或 `41`/`1%` 时会与轴标签文本相撞，表格即使含对的格子也可能被判错。

## 不确定的
图内标题 `Emissions shares by groups` 是副标题还是面板标题，无法从图面判定；左轴标题是否被视为单位短语（刻度已带 `%`）也只能推断；`Interpretation.` 段落是否属于图的一部分（其宽度与图不同）无法确认。

heading.title: Emissions are highly concentrated among the rich,
heading.subtitle: especially when looking at ownership | Emissions shares by groups

axes.serves: all eight bars, green and red alike
the four category slots holding the bar pairs

worked_example.why_hard: Needs both a category tick and a legend colour name; category text itself contains a percentage.

components.evidence: two bars, green then red, sit side by side inside each of the four category slots
`77%`, `47%`, `3%` printed just above the top of each bar, outside the mark
green and red swatches with `Consumption` and `Private ownership` centred under the category axis
dashed horizontal rules at every 10% tick; no vertical rules cross the panel
`Share in total emissions` set vertically along the left axis
`Interpretation.` paragraph then `Sources and series:` Bruckner et al. (2022) and Chancel and Rehm (2025b).

new_components.evidence: axis ticks read `Bottom 50%`, `Top 10%`, `Top 1%` while plotted values are also percentages

answer.hardest_step_why: 值全部印出，读数无碍；难在标签：10 与类别名 `Top 10%`、41 与 `Top 1%` 文本相撞，且每值需类别加图例两标签。

examples.quote: `Figure 6.2. Emissions are highly concentrated among the rich, especially when looking at ownership` above, then `Emissions shares by groups` above the plot
examples.why: 编号、两行标题与图内标题分三层；当前流水线只有单一标题字段，无法复现层级与位置。

examples.quote: Every bar carries its number above it as `10%`, `3%`, `77%`; left ticks read `0%` to `90%`
examples.why: 数值标签外置且带百分号、刻度同样带 `%`，标签位置与刻度格式需成为可控风格维度。

examples.quote: `Interpretation.` ... `Sources and series:` Bruckner et al. (2022) and Chancel and Rehm (2025b).
examples.why: 整页导出需保留粗体引导词的长说明块与来源行，及其相对表格的位置。

examples.quote: x ticks read `Bottom 50%`, `Middle 40%`, `Top 10%`, `Top 1%` while plotted values are also percentages
examples.why: 类别名内含百分数会与数值检索相撞；需生成并标注这类易混标签以测评定位鲁棒性。
